fields.label: Open cases
fields.populationNote: Counts cases with no close date whose status is not a terminal or not-yet-started one, so a resolved-but-unclosed case does not count. The Portfolio badge counts a wider set, and the two can legitimately differ for the same account.

fields.label: Escalated cases
fields.populationNote: Escalated cases only, within the same population. Counts cases with no close date whose status is not a terminal or not-yet-started one, so a resolved-but-unclosed case does not count. The Portfolio badge counts a wider set, and the two can legitimately differ for the same account.

fields.label: Oldest open case (days)
fields.populationNote: Age of the oldest case in that same population. Counts cases with no close date whose status is not a terminal or not-yet-started one, so a resolved-but-unclosed case does not count. The Portfolio badge counts a wider set, and the two can legitimately differ for the same account.
